landing_page.welcome_text: Discover a world of puzzles! Our website is dedicated to provide with comprehensive data on speed puzzle competitions, puzzle times, and much more. Whether you're a puzzle enthusiast or a competitive solver, you'll find valuable information and resources here.
landing_page.participant_welcome_text: Participate in thrilling speed puzzle competitions, self-register for any category, and check real-time results once they end.
landing_page.organizer_welcome_text: Publish new competitions, manage participants, and monitor performance in real time.
